title: Design System: DOMENEA Cinematic Prototype V2

motion.name: ease-spatial
motion.purpose: Scene title, menu and media-settle transitions.

components.name: Text Action
components.description: Primary conversion action expressed as typography rather than a filled button.

components.name: Menu Action
components.description: Peripheral menu control used in the fixed header.

components.name: Scene Rail Item
components.description: Hairline scene state indicator for the desktop cinematic sequence.

narrative.overview: DOMENEA is presented as an architectural experience before it behaves like a property catalogue. Full-screen media carries the emotional load while typography behaves like signage inside the landscape. Mineral editorial interludes create pauses for project understanding.
keyCharacteristics: Mineral paper interludes between immersive scenes.

rules.name: The Image Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated color comes from photography and film, not from UI chrome.

rules.name: The Spatial Type Rule
rules.body: Display type belongs to a scene, not inside a container.

rules.name: The No Floating UI Rule
rules.body: Navigation may overlay media, but it does not become a card, glass panel or elevated surface.

dos: Do let one decisive image carry each immersive scene.
Do keep navigation and factual labels peripheral.
Do use long quiet editorial sections to reset the eye between scenes.
Do treat motion as camera language rather than decoration.
donts: Don't reintroduce property cards, glass panels or rounded content containers into this prototype language.
Don't use decorative gradients, glowing accents or gradient text.
Don't copy imagery, copywriting or brand assets from reference websites.
